h: Complete Faith Reveals One Name Within and Without

p: In the Minchah prayer of Shabbos
we say, "You are One and Your Name is One."
ה׳ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד (זְכַרְיָה יד, ט)
Hashem will be One and His Name One' (Zechariah 14:9)
אַטּוּ הָאִידָּנָא לָאו אֶחָד הוּא וְכוּלֵּי
is He then not One today? etc.
it will all be 'Who is good and does good.'"
Now, as for our saying "You are One,"
יִתָּכֵן דְּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א מח, ב)
it can be explained, for in the holy Zohar (I 48b)
"On the day that Hashem gives you rest, etc.,
as referring to the day of Shabbos;
for on Shabbos there is rest for Yisrael;
even while they are still in the hard labor,
for he sees that everything is for the good,
and then it is all "Who is good and does good";
But as for our saying "and Your Name is One"
to mean that in the World to Come
it will be written with Yud-Hei
the Name Havayah is not pronounced
so why do we say now
But it is found in the Ra'aya Mehemna
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
that it enumerates all the ten Sefiros
that are alluded to in the Name Havayah:
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ רנח, א)
(as is written in the holy Zohar, this parsha, III 258a);
and the upper tip of the Yud alludes to Ayin
that in the Name Adnus, too,
the ten Sefiros are alluded to,
and likewise, "He is truth and She is faith,"
"He is prophet and She is prophecy"
and corresponding to the attribute of Netzach,
it enumerates "He is humble and She is humility";
"He is righteous and She is righteous";
"He is king and She is kingship."
"He is wise and She is wisdom, etc."
כָּל מִי שֶׁאֵין תּוֹכוֹ כְּבָרוֹ וְכוּלֵּי
'Whoever is not the same within as without, etc.';
and the Shechinah is the outside;
and She is the outside, without."
Only that in the Gemara there, regarding a person,
וְצָרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה תּוֹכוֹ גַּם כֵּן טוֹב
and his inside must also be good,
whereas here in the holy Zohar the meaning is
is like the inside, the Name Havayah,
"And the outer one does not differ
He is called only by His Shechinah, Adnus."
That is because in truth all is One,
and in the World to Come
the reading too will be with Havayah.
וּבְגִין דָּא מַנֵּי קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
"And therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, commanded
מַאן דְּלָא יְהֵא תּוֹכוֹ כְּבָרוֹ וְכוּלֵּי
whoever is not the same within as without, etc."
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּגְּמָרָא (בְּרָכוֹת כח, א)
And this is along the lines of what is written in the Gemara (Berachos 28a):
they removed the guard of the door, etc."
For the guard of the door
בֵּין מִי שֶׁתּוֹכוֹ כְּבָרוֹ אוֹ לָאו
between one whose inside is like his outside and one who is not.
that from the utterance of Rabban Gamliel,
שֶׁאָמַר שֶׁכָּל מִי שֶׁאֵין תּוֹכוֹ כְּבָרוֹ
who said that whoever is not the same within as without
was the guard of the door;
that is, from the utterance of Rabban Gamliel
and he was the guard of the door.
And as for what it says in the Ra'aya Mehemna:
"Whoever is not the same within as without
in all limbs, inner and outer,
this is based on what it says
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא לְקַמָּן, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רלד, ב)
from the Tree of good and evil,
there is no limb in the body
דְּלֵית בֵּיהּ יֵצֶר הָרָע וְיֵצֶר הַטּוֹב
that does not have in it an evil inclination and a good inclination
like a groom and bride, etc."
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
And this is what it says in the holy Zohar cited above,
meaning that it not be from the side
an evil inclination and a good inclination,
but that it be like a groom and bride,
the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah
that his inside and outside be one.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר גַּם כֵּן בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא
And this is what it also says in the Ra'aya Mehemna
"Whoever is not the same within as without, etc.
from the side of the Tree of Life
but from the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil";
meaning a good inclination and an evil inclination,
there is faith in its completeness,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 88a):
and on the Field of holy apples."
a Jew merits faith in its completeness
through the three holinesses of Shabbos,
which are the three holinesses of the meals;
that all is one, inside and outside.
"Just as in your heart there is only One,
so in our heart there is only One."
That is: even though in this world
one cannot attain the unity clearly,
שֶׁזֶּה הָיָה רַק בְּיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
for that was only in Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is the attribute of truth,
and became a chariot for the Name Havayah
nevertheless one can attain the unity
And this is what they said:
"so in our heart there is only One"
And although it is not revealed in this world,
כָּל חַד לְפוּם מַאי דִּמְשַׁעֵר בְּלִבֵּיהּ
"each one according to what he estimates in his heart,"
"Her husband is known in the gates,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קג, ב)
as it says in the holy Zohar (I 103b);
in the aspect of being read as it is written,
"and the outer one does not differ
and the inside is like the outside
And this is why we say in the Minchah prayer of Shabbos,
which corresponds to the third meal,
"You are One and Your Name is One";
for one can attain the unity,
כָּל חַד לְפוּם מַה דִּמְשַׁעֵר בְּלִבֵּיהּ
each one according to what he estimates in his heart,
"to see the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin."
